description: OACoder attaches Output Area Classification codes to postcode-addressed records in the United Kingdom. Muhammad Adnan, Alex Singleton and Paul A. Longley publish a Java tool for linking user records to the small-area geodemographic classification. The archive describes Windows operation and reusable CSV reading and writing components. Coverage follows the historical OAC linkage supplied with the published software; the description treats support for the 2011 OAC as a possible extension, not an implemented feature. The resulting codes can help stratify population and demand inputs for related transport or public-service simulations. Source code is free under GPL-3.0, although the Figshare archive also has a CC BY metadata label. A limitation is the age of both postcode geography and the software environment, so current boundaries or newer classifications require additional checks and development. No postcode file, archive or executable was downloaded.
